blocks.text: Preserved release-note state
The archived Apple reader identifies this document as “iOS & iPadOS 16 Beta Release Notes.” This iOS page selects 16 substantive records from the 143-record initial state.
How this milestone differs

This page is a representative baseline, not an exhaustive conversion of all 143 initial records. Only exact issue-ID additions or meaningful status transitions are used for later milestones; wording-only edits are not presented as release changes.
Platform scope
The selection retains shared SDK records and notes explicitly scoped to iPhone or iOS. iPad-only Stage Manager, external-display, and iPad hardware claims are excluded.

changes.title: StoreKit app-purchase verification
changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit added a cryptographic way for an app to verify that its copy was obtained through the App Store.
changes.summary: The initial SDK notes describe an app-purchase verification capability for checking App Store provenance.

changes.canonicalSummary: StoreKit transaction and renewal information gained metadata identifying the server environment in which each record originated.
changes.summary: Apps can distinguish the server environment associated with transaction and subscription-renewal information.

changes.canonicalSummary: The new RoomPlan framework used device sensing and machine learning to construct parametric 3D room models with custom-interface and USD export support.

changes.canonicalSummary: SwiftUI text fields gained an axis-based multiline mode for short and medium-length editable text.
